aiVerification.summary: The source is citeable, but the draft misgroups the changed factor and mixes diagnostics, departments, lines, and jig conditions.
issues: Changed factor is a noisy mix of departments, lines, jig versions, and tests.
Baseline/test framing should center on cutting-coil improvement using Laser Cap JIG V1 and proper setting.
AWF jig, AWF machine, axis reset, V0, V1, before/after, and offset tests need separate subgroup context.
Outcome domains and conditions contain extraction artifacts such as line/no values and numeric offsets as primary labels.
Cited rows Test (3)!38-42 are not shown in contextRows, reducing auditability.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as Laser Cap JIG use/version/setting versus before improve, V0, and offset conditions.
Keep department, date, line, test number, and machine position as subgroup keys only.
Regroup outcomes into before/after NG rate, jig version validation, AWF/machine checks, and offset-setting trouble tests.
Remove irrelevant change domains and extraction artifacts from changedCondition and subgroupKeys.
Add displayed context text for all cited evidence rows, especially Test (3)!38-42.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations mostly exist and are relevant, but final evidence needs cleaner grouping and full cited-row context.
